global.title: Weekly ISS update: Kutryk to become fifth Canadian spacewalker
global.summary: Canadian Space Agency (CSA) astronaut Joshua Kutryk is scheduled to make two spacewalks at the International Space Station in the next few weeks to install new solar arrays, NASA said Oct. 14. A SpaceX cargo ship delivered the arrays a day later. Power upgrade Kutryk and NASA’s Anil Menon will fit the station’s seventh and eighth roll-out solar arrays, finishing an upgrade that NASA says will raise the station’s power generation capacity by up to 30 per cent. Kutryk will become the fifth Canadia
